name: Abner
summary: The captain of Saul's army, who after Saul's death made Saul's son Ish-bosheth king over Israel. He later turned to David, but Joab killed him at Hebron.

key_moments.title: Asleep on Guard
key_moments.description: While Saul's camp slept, David took Saul's spear and water jar. From a hilltop David called to Abner and asked why he had not guarded his king.

key_moments.title: Making a King for Israel
key_moments.description: Abner took Ish-bosheth, Saul's son, to Mahanaim and made him king over Israel, while the house of Judah followed David.

key_moments.title: Killing Asahel
key_moments.description: Fast-running Asahel, the brother of Joab, chased Abner and would not turn aside though Abner warned him. Abner struck him with the back end of his spear, and Asahel died.

key_moments.title: Killed in the Gate of Hebron
key_moments.description: Abner came to David at Hebron to bring all Israel over to him. Joab took him aside in the gate and killed him for the blood of Asahel, and David wept at his grave.
